gaps.sentence: They accused him ___ lying to the committee.
His account of the accident tallies ___ the CCTV footage.
gaps.explanation: 'Tally with' = correspond exactly to something else.

gaps.sentence: They grew suspicious ___ his constant absences.
The whole project hinges ___ council approval.
They've invited us ___ their wedding in May.
The minister refused to comment ___ the scandal.
We arrived ___ the airport two hours early.
gaps.explanation: arrive AT a point (airport, hotel), IN a city/country.

gaps.sentence: The lake teems ___ trout in early summer.
gaps.explanation: 'Teem with' = be full of living things moving about.
